ex.ar: كَانَ مُتَضَايِقًا مِنَ الضَّجِيجِ فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعِ النَّوْمَ.
ex.en: He was bothered by the noise, so he couldn't sleep.

entries.ety: Active participle of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa, “to be annoyed”).

ex.en: The government is fighting the drug trade.

senses.head: to turn out (to be) (+ إِنّو: that)

ex.en: It turned out my friend knows your brother!

entries.ety: Levantine form of طَلَعَ (ṭalaʿa). In Modern Standard Arabic, “it turned out that” is تَبَيَّنَ أَنَّ.

senses.head: to praise (a person), to speak highly of

ex.en: Everyone is speaking highly of you.

entries.ety: شَكَرَ (šakara, “to thank”) with في. In Modern Standard Arabic, “to praise” is أَثْنَى عَلَى.
طُول (“length”) + عُمْر (“lifetime”) with a possessive suffix: طول عُمري, طول عُمرَك … In Modern Standard Arabic, طَوَالَ حَيَاتِه.
